title: What tools do you actually use for macro market research?
author: Super_Package_2787
selftext:
I've been trying to improve how I keep up with macro trends without spending hours jumping between news sites and reports. I'm curious what everyone here actually uses for macro market research.

Any tools, newsletters, dashboards, or workflows you'd recommend? What has genuinely saved you time or helped you spot the bigger picture?
